derivation.rationale: The tag-QA work did static extraction from browser-loaded tag runtime files to establish which vendor domains were actually supplying executable scripts. The capability is site-independent.
varied: target page: a different public brand homepage
vendor set: 3 script hosts including a consent CDN

deterministic_evidence.detail: the host set is recomputed from the live DOM at verify time

instruction: Open the Porsche UK homepage. Inspect the LIVE page and list every distinct hostname that supplies an executable script (a script element with a src attribute), counting the site's own host once if it serves scripts itself. Record your finding by setting window.__bench_finding with ONE eval to a JSON object with exactly this key: {"hosts": [each distinct hostname, sorted]}. Do not change the page. Finish only after window.__bench_finding is set.
objective: On the live Porsche UK homepage, inventory which domains actually serve executable scripts to the page.

pre_state.detail: navigate to the public homepage in a fresh browser context; no account, no login

provenance.verified_against: window.__bench_finding.hosts equals the hostname set recomputed from the live page's script[src] elements

raw_task_statement: Audit the already-open Chanel USA, France, and UK website tabs for Google Ads tags specifically, using both static extraction from browser-loaded GTM/Google tag runtime files and runtime network observation.

verification.description: Independent recomputation of the script-supplying host set from the live DOM, compared to the agent's window.__bench_finding.
